newsitem.title: USA: Wyser-Pratte says Rexene withheld info.
newsitem.headline: Wyser-Pratte says Rexene withheld info.

text.p: Dissident stockholders on Thursday accused Rexene Corp of improperly suppressing significant information about potential buyers.

Wyser-Pratte & Co and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg said Rexene filed a preliminary proxy statement on Tuesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission that for the first time disclosed that the company was contacted by four potential buyers after Huntsman Corp expressed interest in buying Rexene for $16 per share.

"This egregious failure to disclose for months these discussions with potential buyers, in the midst of a consent solicitation, was obviously done to help Rexene try to stave off our call for a special meeting, an effort which ultimately failed," Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds said in a statement.
Rexene was trading at 13-7/8 on Thursday. A special shareholders meeting is scheduled for April 30.

Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds, which own a combined 13.2 percent of Rexene, welcomed Huntsman's offer. Rexene management initially rejected the offer, but later said it would not oppose a fully funded cash offer.
Rexene officials said they would not comment until they had a chance to review the allegations.
